newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates remain at low levels.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates remain at low levels.

text.p: Pakistan's overnight money market rates remained at low levels on Thursday amid a low borrowing interest, dealers said.
The overnights offers started at 7.00 percent but bids were around 3.00 percent, one dealer said.
"Finally, the deals were struck at 3.00 percent owing to a lack of borowing interest," he said.
The rates were expected to stay soft until the next open market operation by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan, the dealer said.
